paper_title: Shining Light on the Dark Sector: Search for Axion-like Particles and Other New Physics in Photonic Final States with FASER
notes: FASER search for ALPs decaying to two photons using 57.7 fb^-1 of 13.6 TeV pp collision data. The PRIMARY and world-leading result is on the ALP-W model (coupling g_aWW to weak gauge bosons, excluding 3e-5 to 5e-4 GeV^-1 for masses 100-250 MeV), which does not map to any enum coupling type. The paper also presents an ALP-photon interpretation (g_agamma), which maps to AxionPhoton: 'FASER can probe ALP masses up to 80 MeV and couplings down to 1e-4 GeV^-1.' Only sparse text values are available since numerical limits are given as exclusion contours in figures (Fig. 11 left panel). The single extracted point (80 MeV, 1e-4 GeV^-1) is approximate. This is a collider bound, so no DM density applies. Confidence is low because (a) the enum does not contain the primary coupling type (g_aWW/AxionW), and (b) only very approximate numerical values are available from text, not tables or digitized plots. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.4, 1))
